title: GLua Script Free or Premium
features:
PREMIUM FEATURES
--- Automation ---

• Auto Fish – Perfect catches every time

• Auto Sell – Sells inventory automatically at set intervals

• Auto Event – Auto Teleport to Event (Megalodon Hunt, Worm Hunt, Etc.)

• Auto Favorite – Favorites fish by rarity, weight, or special traits


--- Auto Purchase & Upgrades ---

• Auto Buy Best – Buys best affordable equipment automatically

• Auto Buy Weather – Buys weather automatically

• Auto Enchant – Uses enchant stones on selected rod


--- Utilities & Features ---

• Holy Trident Animation – Change default animation to Skin Rod Holy Trident

• FPS Boost – Reduce lag and boost FPS by lowering text

• Discord Webhooks – Notifications for rare catches, backpack, and more.

• Player Tools – Anti-AFK, Anti-Drown, speed controls

• Teleports – Instant travel to islands, NPCs, or players

• Server Hop – Switch servers by population
